about.lead: YZX Precision centers on mold punch pins and punches — 15 years serving stamping and progressive die shops, with ejector, guide and spring lines for add-on sourcing.
manufacturerBody: Custom mold punch pins and punches in carbide, HSS and tool steel — round, square, stepped and special profiles, A-type and pilot-style pins — plus ejector, guide, spring and bronze catalog lines for the same mold project.
Flow: drawing review → sample approval → batch → 100% critical check. Send CAD, PDF, STEP/DWG or a sample; we confirm material, tolerance and routing before quote.
productHighlights: Punches: carbide, HSS, stepped, special, stamping and tableting tooling
Ejection: straight, shoulder, stepped, blade pins, sleeves, air valves
Guiding: posts, bushings, sets, ball cages and bearing bushings
Accessories: die springs, gas springs, sprue bushings, dowel pins, bronze wear parts
inspectionPoints: Optical projectors for profile and angle checks
Calipers, micrometers and height gauges in daily use
100% check on critical dimensions before shipment; reports on request
Special tolerances and GD&T noted on your drawing — confirmed before production

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: We accept orders from 1 piece for custom items. Batch pricing applies for larger quantities.
Sample lead time is typically 3–7 working days after drawing confirmation, depending on complexity.
We routinely work to ±0.002mm on critical dimensions. Tighter tolerance is available on request — please mark it on your drawing.

items.q: Can you copy from a physical sample without a drawing?
items.a: Yes. Send the sample — we measure and produce a product drawing for your approval before manufacturing.

items.q: Which file formats do you accept?
items.a: STEP, IGES, DWG, DXF, PDF, and JPG/PNG sketches. If unsure, email us — we will guide you.
